notes.title: Update Version 1.0
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This is the last major update for Survival Hold Your Self.[/p][p]Please read the patch notes. If you have any questions or find any further bugs, please use the Discord server. Thank you.[/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]1. Compass display is no longer visible when a different UI is open.[/p][p]2. Game performance improved.[/p][p]3. Sound bugs at the waterfront fixed.[/p][p]4. Bandits sometimes didn't attack the player. Fixed.[/p][p]New Features:[/p][p]You can now purchase an NPC companion from the merchant. This companion can craft items at a crafting table you can build without requiring a request, but it takes a little longer.[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Gameplay Features - What can you expect from the game
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today I'd like to give you a list of things you can expect in the game. But first, I'd like to share with you the current status.
I've been working on the save system lately. This difficult topic is now complete and can be checked off. I'm still planning to release the game around August/September, assuming no major issues arise. Therefore, a three-week test phase is now starting, where I'll play through the game myself and look for potential bugs. At the same time, I'll try to add Steam achievements for those who enjoy collecting them. I'll let you know a more precise release date around July. And now we come to the list of what you can expect in the game.


1. Crafting at multiple crafting stations
2. Base building and furniture construction
3. Day-night cycle
4. Quest system (repeatable)
5. Dog companion (purchase from the merchant)
6. Merchant system
7. Open world consists of different islands with different resources and animals.
8. Flying with a helicopter (must be found in the open world)
9. ​​Drill system (Endgame! Drill needs fuel)
10. Looting (with loot reset)
11. Surviving in the wild against wild animals and bandits
